method: Freeze the selected execution journal/capsule as the criterion anchor. Final prose/evidence/index changes rerun host audits and strict artifact re-review only. A local locator records the last host-closure journal and hashes after staging, without recursively changing tracked evidence.
capsule_scope: Complete selected execution streams and original journal; later final-index host closure is retained separately through the locator.
deletion: none; exact original artifacts retained for active review/resume; owner defers all deletion
